liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Here Comes Sunshine** (1 review): Described as shimmering and jammed out by the standards of the later era [11]
- **Terrapin Station** (1 review): Phil's playing in Terrapin is singled out as worth hearing [13]
- **Drums** (1 review): Drums and space are said to work well [14]
- **Morning Dew** (1 review): Called criminally underrated and particularly noteworthy [11]

## The recordings

- **gd1992-12-13.schoeps.boardman.swayne.86041.sbeok.flac16** (recommended): source not stated; 17 songs; 144 min [1]
- **gd1992-12-13.schoeps.boardman.swayne.86037.sbeok.flac1648**: source not stated; 17 songs; 144 min [2]
- **gd1992-12-13.sbd.stonebear.5550.shnf**: soundboard; 15 songs; 143 min; rated 5/5 by 1 [3]. Said about its sound: Great recording; Jerry's guitar sounds sweet throughout [14]
- **gd1992-12-13.fob.neumann.copeland.gems.79352.sbeok.flac16**: source not stated; 16 songs; 149 min; rated 4/5 by 1 [4]. Said about its sound: Recording is very clear, deep and balanced [15]
- **gd1992-12-13.140381.fob.Schoeps-MK41.miller.sirmick.flac1648**: source not stated; 16 songs; 150 min [7]
- **gd92-12-13.sbd-2track.barbella.10928.sbeok.shnf**: soundboard; 16 songs; 140 min; rated 3/5 by 4 [8]. Said about its sound: Excellent sound with decent vocals; The mix sounds really nice [12][13]

## Around the show

- A short show, but the band jams together and builds a strong rhythm [12]
- Crowd sound is retained as part of the performance, and tracked across three CD-Rs [4]
- The 16th gets most attention from the run, but this show deserves notice too [11]
- Feels more relaxed than the energetic show on the 12th [13]
- Possibly not the best of the run; first set superb, second set noticeably less energetic [15]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd1992-12-13.schoeps.boardman.swayne.86041.sbeok.flac16**: taped by Ed Boardman; transferred by Scott Swayne; source: Schoeps CMC441's > Panasonic SV-255 > (clone) Teac DA-P20 [1]
- **gd1992-12-13.schoeps.boardman.swayne.86037.sbeok.flac1648**: taped by Ed Boardman; transferred by Scott Swayne; source: Schoeps CMC441's > Panasonic SV-255 > (clone) Teac DA-P20 [2]. Also: This is the 48k version of an Ed Boardman recording; a 44.1k version was also seeded [2]
- **gd1992-12-13.sbd.stonebear.5550.shnf**: transferred by seeded to etree by StoneBear; source: Dan Healy 2 track pa sbd dat master > Healy cassette (made by Dan for Phil Lesh) > absconded & confiscated by Dick Latvala : ^) > analog to digital by kingbee… [3]
- **gd1992-12-13.fob.neumann.copeland.gems.79352.sbeok.flac16**: taped by Chip Copeland; transferred by Jamie Waddell; source: Neumann km140 (110 deg. ORTF) -> Neumann Supply -> Panasonic sv255 [4]. Also: First circulating audience source from this date, a front-of-board recording with gems lineage [4]
- **gd1992-12-13.140381.fob.Schoeps-MK41.miller.sirmick.flac1648**: transferred by Charlie Miller and SIRMick; source: flac16/48kHz ; Source: (FOB) Schoeps MK41 > Panasonic SV-255 > dat(48k); Transfer: dat > Sony PCM-R500 > Tascam DA-3000> wav 16/48; Lineage: wav > iZotope RX6… [7]. Also: Source from Charlie Miller's transfer, using Schoeps MK41 mics; two 3-second patches added in Tennessee Jed from Boardman and Swayne's recording [7]
- **gd92-12-13.sbd-2track.barbella.10928.sbeok.shnf**: source: Soundboard [8]

## Art and photos

- Fan art by Sameh Tawfik Grateful Dead: [1992-12-16 Oakland-Alameda County Coliseum, Oakland, CA, USA - Jerry Garcia](https://jerrygarcia.com/show/1992-12-16-oakland-alameda-county-coliseum-oakland-ca-usa/) [18]
